cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay till sunset. Gran said this stone would hatch. I taught you to keep a proper observation record; I need your name beside mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, write what you saw, not what she hoped. You used to mix those up. Sign and we can call it disproved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but she never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're checking the wording at last. Stay while we ring her for a date. Don't leave your old teacher doing this every evening.
